# WizLeads Blog

> B2B lead generation tips, cold email strategies, Sales Navigator tutorials, and product updates from WizLeads.

## About

WizLeads is the all-in-one B2B lead generation tool. Scrape LinkedIn Sales Navigator, find verified business emails, and verify in bulk. This blog covers outbound sales strategies, email deliverability, lead enrichment workflows, and product updates.

## Research

Original benchmarks run by WizLeads. Each tool was tested on the same data set.

- [Email Enrichment Benchmark 2026: 7 Email Finders, 1,000 B2B Leads](https://wizleads.io/blog/email-enrichment-benchmark-2026/): WizLeads delivered 670 verified-valid emails out of 1,000 leads – the highest count in the test, with zero invalids on verify.
- [Email Verification Benchmark 2026: 6 Tools, 1,000 Emails](https://wizleads.io/blog/email-verification-benchmark-2026/): We tested WizLeads, ZeroBounce, LeadMagic, NeverBounce, MillionVerifier and Debounce on 1,000 B2B emails.
